status: Design baseline for Codex; numeric settings provisional until Atari800 playtest

frame_clock.simulation: exactly one movement update per observed VBI tick; no repeated moves in same tick
frame_clock.accumulated_delta_policy: bounded catch-up; do not skip wall collisions or let one stalled frame tunnel across walls

coordinate_space.position_representation: player top-left in 1/16 logical pixel units; renderer must show sub-tile motion

player_movement.movement_control: joystick 1, continuous movement while held, immediate change on direction
player_movement.movement_input_polling: read joystick once per game tick; do not gate reads or movement on legacy 8-frame tile step timer
player_movement.diagonal_behavior: allow 8-way walking with speed normalization; keep blast 4-direction only in future v0.5
player_movement.start_stop: instant for v0.4; no acceleration or inertia
player_movement.priority: movement processed before enemy collision resolution on each frame; caught if hitboxes overlap after both movement updates
player_movement.diagonal_corner_policy: no corner clipping; resolve axes against full inset AABB, attempt permitted axis independently for wall slide
player_movement.wall_slide: when one component blocked, allow free component at cardinal speed (24/16 px per frame), including along counters and shelving

room_transition.trigger: Billy collision-box center first enters mapped D tile
room_transition.entry_position: top-left aligns to destination x=1 or x=38 tile, and doorway y=10 or 11; reset fractional position
room_transition.door_guard: do not permit automatic immediate reverse transition without entering another doorway after spawn

finish.trigger: Billy collision-box center enters storage X=(39,10)

enemy_interactions.inherit: Preserve v0.3 three hazmat worker identities, activation delays, room follow, BFS scheduling, stunned state legacy internal data and win/restart
enemy_interactions.enemy_motion: retain existing tile-based chase and v0.3 timings; do not tune difficulty in movement-only iteration
enemy_interactions.catch_rule: Billy inset 6x6 pixel hitbox intersects the enemy's inset 6x6 hitbox centered on its 8x8 tile, if enemy is active, not stunned, and contact grace is exhausted
enemy_interactions.restore_player_state: Stage restart returns dining Billy spawn (7,15) in exact pixel alignment, clears x/y fractional state, and resets old Stage 1 state

blast_v04.reason: v0.3 blast was unsatisfying; isolate movement feel now, redesign fire/aim/visual/knockback in v0.5
blast_v04.fire_button_in_gameplay: ignored for v0.4 movement; holding Fire must not stop walking or trigger cooldown
blast_v04.prior_behavior_preservation: Keep v0.3 source and XEX available on its feature branch; no deletion of prior feature or tests. Do not change earlier cutscene Fire progression.
blast_v04.later: v0.5 will separately specify four-cardinal-direction indoor gas attacks; road controls unchanged

display.stage1_camera: three fixed full-screen 40x22 rooms, plus two footer rows, no scrolling
display.implementation_choices: Use actual hardware PMG for Billy alone if memory/display timing is safe, or a correctly clipped software sprite with background restoration; no character-cell snapping masquerading as pixel movement
display.graphics_scope: temporary sprite allowed; no redesign of title/cutscenes/art/music

playtest.target: smooth, fast, responsive movement rather than elapsed stage duration
playtest.compare_to_v03: v0.3 nominal 8 pixels per 8 frames => approximately 60 pixels over 60 frames
tests: continuous motion within a tile, not whole-cell jumps
diagonal speed comparable to cardinal speed
no crossing of 2-tile doorway at invalid y
all 4 forward/reverse room transitions and backtracking
room transition from fractional position resets cleanly
no repeated transition on held input
enemy overlap at sub-tile positions, stun/contact grace correctness
three hazmat workers keep unique IDs and state
CAUGHT and START reset at exact aligned spawn
storage X triggers at hitbox center
Fire is inert and does not freeze movement
opening START/FIRE and both original POKEY songs remain unchanged
CPU/frame budget and XEX segment overlaps verified
metrics: can steer precisely around a table
ability to dodge a pursuer without gas blast
any VBI stalls during room change
